Package dataProviders

Class ConfigFileReader

java.lang.Object
dataProviders.ConfigFileReader
public class ConfigFileReader extends Object
Reads configuration.properties from the test classpath. A JVM system property with the same key (e.g. -Dbrowser=firefox) overrides the file.
